description: Where Sense2 delivers in Australia, with a dedicated page per city, state and territory. Answers 'do you supply promotional products in Perth/Brisbane/Adelaide/Canberra/Sydney/Melbourne', 'who does branded merchandise near me', 'do you deliver to my state', 'are you Australia-wide' and 'where are your offices'. Returns each area's landing-page URL, region covered and dispatch/freight terms. Pass a slug (e.g. 'perth') for one area including its full intro. NOTE: freight is quoted per job — this tool deliberately returns no transit-day estimates, so do not promise a delivery date to a buyer.

slug.description: Optional city/state slug, e.g. 'perth', 'brisbane', 'queensland'. Omit for all areas.
